name: mcp-cash-book
description: MCP server for double entry bookkeeping and a cash book general ledger for a small business. One double-entry ledger derived from the books you already keep, proved to the minor unit.

settings.name: mcp.zovo.one token
settings.description: A free anonymous token from https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/token, or your Pro key. One token is one data space, and it is refreshed for another 30 days on every write.

cash-book.description: One double-entry ledger derived from the books you already keep, proved to the minor unit.
